opening.argument: The presentation expressly ties earnings to purchases made by people in an unlimited-depth downline, stating that if someone on the weaker side buys the 5,000 euro package, the speaker will earn a $500 bonus. It presents a binary compensation plan with two teams, while the slide shows a 5,030 euro Tycoon package converted into 12,000 coins, split into 48,000 coins, and displayed as worth 24,000 euros at a 0.50 euro coin price. The presentation also projects future coin values, including an optimistic $5 per coin scenario, and urges viewers not to miss the program or business. Although it includes general income and prediction disclaimers, its central message solicits package purchases and partnership through recruitment-dependent commissions and highly optimistic projected returns.
